goal_source: Owner decision, 2026-11-24: flat monthly subscriptions that give a lot of value are welcome; pay-per-token is not (Git Crafter rules/compute.md, Money). The $49 is Code Security and Secret Protection for one committer on one private repo, recorded in compute.spend_exceptions. Near adds one more committer's Secret Protection ($19, github.com/security/plans).

Off: GitHub Pages sends no custom response headers. This page is built in CI from collected data and its build output is never committed (AGENTS.md), so serving it from Cloudflare Pages needs a CI deploy with a stored token, and any host change needs a second production URL, for the +0.2 points the live work queue shows (read 2026-11-25) (issue 249). Its params stay. Delete the drop if the site moves to a host that sets headers
